descriptions.w3d_d27a_fade_in_update_80043b74: Starting from the colour at +32, if the time since +88 is past 0x804aa974, it sets the position to 0x8042745c, the state +64 to 2 and +88 to the time. Otherwise it lerps the position from 0x80427468 to 0x8042745c by a sine of the elapsed fraction and +48 to +32 by the clamped fraction, clamping each channel to 0..1. Then it finds the object by handle +68, sets the position through a virtual call, converts the colour to bytes and passes it to 0x8011adf8.
